power.jaymospowers.chrono.desc: Bend the flow of time. Rewind your last moments, freeze foes, and fast-forward yourself or the world.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_2: Stasis Field: stop time around you for 3s (players too) and reset all your other cooldowns
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_3: Overclock: a speedster for 6 s (Speed V, faster blows), everyone near you slowed hard. Sprint to go far faster, run up walls and across water and lava; V again at a wall to phase through it. Hold Shift to walk at normal speed. All four abilities unlocked: a toggle, on until V again (away from a wall)
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ability_4: Time Bloom (grow and cook fast, and mend your wounds and those of every creature near you). Sneak+B, once you've killed your echo for good: Fast Forward, a leap to the ruined future (and back) with everyone near you
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate: Chrono Punch: ten punches in half a second into everything in front of you
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_short: Not enough time has passed to rewind.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_tangl: The timeline is tangled across dimensions.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_rewind_block: Your past is blocked. Something stands where you were.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_sighted: Someone is walking where you walked.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_collaps: Somewhere, a moment of yours finally ends.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_clock_woke: You wake. The ticking has stopped.
item.jaymospowers.chrono_stopped_clock.l: Both hands rest on the same moment.
It waits for one who has stood outside time.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.starter: Nudge time: slow what you look at (sneak: speed yourself)
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_unavail: Time won't flow for you like that. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_lent: The echo's blow lands out of time, and time begins to flow through you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_flow_drained: The flow drains out of you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_grab_none: No one close enough to seize.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_stasis: Your own stillness, turned on you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_echo_unravel: Your echo is gone for good, and the hole it leaves runs straight through you. Time comes loose.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.mode.ascen: Time Flow on/off (over-the-shoulder view): attack toward a foe to fly at it; right click to counter held blows, even mid-move. A counter leaves you intangible for a moment: a blow through you flashes red, and Space answers with a spinning kick that throws everyone round you away. Space again spends one of 3 roll charges on stopping time all round you
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate.a: Chrono Punch (in Time Flow: lock onto a foe for a barrage, only a counter breaks it; the last punch throws everything in front away)
message.jaymospowers.future.recharging: The future won't open again for %s s.
message.jaymospowers.future.arrived: A lifetime from now. The dead walk, and only a Chrono's leap or death takes you home.
message.jaymospowers.future.credit: This future is built from Los Perrito City by Uospag (curseforge.com/minecraft/worlds/los-perrito, CC BY 4.0), ruined by Jaymo's Powers. Click to visit the map's page.
message.jaymospowers.future.echo_first: The future won't open while your echo still walks. End it for good first.
message.jaymospowers.future.unlocked: Your echo is gone for good, and time lies open ahead of you. Sneak+B to fast forward.
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.mode.ascen: Time Flow on/off (over-the-shoulder view): attack toward a foe to fly at it; right click to counter held blows, even mid-move. A counter leaves you intangible for a moment: a blow through you flashes red, and Space answers with a spinning kick that throws everyone round you away. Space again spends one of 3 roll charges on stopping time all round you
screen.jaymospowers.order.standby.desc: Your echo keeps near you and fights only what attacks it or you. Between fights it casts Time Bloom where it stands every 30 seconds (once you have Time Bloom).
screen.jaymospowers.order.harvest.desc: Round where you stand now, your echo reaps ripe crops (and replants them), and fells the logs and mines the ores you mine most. The drops go into a chest or barrel close by, or onto the ground.
screen.jaymospowers.order.guard.desc: Your echo holds where you stand now and fights every monster that comes near, with your own Chrono abilities.
screen.jaymospowers.order.loop.desc: Your echo goes back to repeating your last recording.
screen.jaymospowers.order.record.desc: Record up to a minute of what you do (where you walk, what you break, what you strike), then press again: your echo repeats it there, over and over. Ripe crops only; reaped crops are replanted.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.standb: Your echo falls in beside you.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.guard: Your echo will hold this ground.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.loop: Your echo will walk this moment again, and again.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.record: Time is watching what you do...
power.jaymospowers.chrono.key.ultimate.a: Chrono Punch (in Time Flow: lock onto a foe for a barrage, only a counter breaks it; the last punch throws everything in front away)
screen.jaymospowers.order.locked: Not yet. This order comes after %s in-game days of play as Timeless.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_order.unlock: Your echo has learnt to reap for you. (Harvest)
Your echo has learnt to hold ground for you. (Guard)
Your echo has learnt to walk your moments again. (Record)
